# Three.js WebGPU r170

`three.webgpu.js` is byte-identical to `build/three.webgpu.min.js` from the official `three@0.170.0` npm tarball, renamed only for readable import paths. MIT license is retained in `LICENSE` and the bundle header.

Source: https://registry.npmjs.org/three/-/three-0.170.0.tgz

Bundle SHA-256: `9d01bb1bae1badb5071d341f76c3569f6118bad126effd425a06611a9d993035`.

The original `dist/vendor/three.module.js`, Reflector and utilities are untouched. This bundle is loaded by the sky validation fixture; the full game stays on the original bundle until all effects are ported.
